summary.text: Sandeep Srivastava is the Democratic nominee for the Texas House of Representatives, District 66.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a longtime Plano/Frisco resident, small business owner and community advocate.

paragraphs.text: Srivastava earned a bachelor's degree from Lucknow University in 1986, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as real estate.
He said he is a first-generation immigrant who has helped build and operate childcare centers across the Dallas-Fort Worth area and who founded a nonprofit organization supporting new immigrants.
Srivastava finished fourth in the May 1, 2021 special general election for Plano City Council Place 7, a nonpartisan race that went to a runoff between two other candidates.
He was the Democratic candidate for U.S. House Texas District 3 in 2022 and 2024, losing to Keith Self in both general elections.

In his 2026 survey, Srivastava named home and auto insurance premiums, property taxes and public education among his key messages, saying he opposes school vouchers and supports fully funding public schools.
He also named public and school safety as a policy area he is passionate about.
